title: Where is Memphis Minnie; Lewis's lack of income
summary: They ask after Memphis Minnie, and Lewis says he still has no income coming in.

story.theme_name: Making a living: hard times, day jobs and scarce work
story.community_name: Day jobs: musicians working outside music

blocks.x: Yeah well. You need to find a good lawyer around here. They'll do something for you. Oh what happened to Memphis Manny?
Well now I'll tell you one thing. I don't know what she did or not. Before she ever hear from her or heard of what she did or not.
I'll try to find out for her. Oh good. I'm about to find her.
We'll try to find out something about that tomorrow. You don't know when you'll be back in here though do you?
Well I'll try to come back by tomorrow. Well you do that. And Jack will bring the guitar in there.

Well I hope he will then we can have a little music or something. Yeah. Because I haven't. You see it's like I tell you. I do some money to come in but it's have never started yet. You know how it is when you just. Yeah. Well I know. Ain't got no kind of income like that. It's pretty tough.
